description: Debt Snowball Calculator with a chart, the same math as the web page. When will you be debt-free? List your debts. Compare two ways to pay them off: smallest first, or highest rate first. It pays every minimum, then puts extra money on one debt at a time. It compares smallest debt first with highest rate first. It does not say which way is right for you. People ask for it as "debt payoff calculator", "debt snowball calculator" or "debt avalanche calculator".
